wrist_rgb.decision_rule: Three consecutive exposures; opposing vertical motion of recess >=8 px and crown >=6 px, spacing change >=12 px; or same-sign displacement >=16 px in both with spacing change <=7 px. Require both tips, two yellow thresholds and two recess thresholds. A physical success alone does not label earlier seating motion. Score against phase-specific archived RGB review; abstentions on confirmed events count as misses.
